description: Nowledge Mem lifecycle hooks — Context Bundle / Working Memory injection and session capture for Copilot CLI

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,pathlib,runpy; r=os.environ.get('COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.environ.get('PLUGIN_ROOT') or os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT') or str(pathlib.Path.home()/'.copilot'/'nowledge-mem-hooks'); p=pathlib.Path(r)/'hooks'/'copilot-hook.py'; runpy.run_path(str(p if p.exists() else pathlib.Path(r)/'copilot-hook.py'), run_name='__main__')" --event session-start
